# Little Paws By Miles

> A small, family-run UK cat breeder based in Leeds, raising GCCF and TICA registered Ragdoll, Maine Coon and British Shorthair kittens. Hobby breeders, not a cattery.

Little Paws By Miles is run by Julia and Mark from their home in Leeds, West Yorkshire. They raise a small number of pedigree kittens each year from their GCCF and TICA registered queens and studs, fully health tested and home-socialised in a busy family environment, and place them at thirteen weeks. Two of their boys, Ralphy (Seal Point Ragdoll) and Starsky (Blue Silver Mackerel Tabby Maine Coon), are dual GCCF and TICA registered and listed on the GCCF Stud Register, available to approved GCCF-registered queens. The site also features family cats who are not part of the breeding programme.

## Pages

- [Home](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/): overview of the breeder, breeds raised, recent litters
- [About Julia and Mark](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/about.html): the people, the kitten suite, and the health and testing standards behind the cattery
- [Meet our cats](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/cats.html): full lineup of queens and studs, grouped by breed
- [Available kittens](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/available-kittens.html): kittens currently looking for their forever homes, plus a waitlist
- [Litters](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/litters.html): current, upcoming, and past litters with detail pages for each
- [Stud services](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/stud-services.html): Ralphy and Starsky, what's included, terms
- [Testimonials](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/testimonials.html): reviews from kitten families and stud queens' owners
- [Contact](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/contact.html): general enquiries via the contact form

## Contact

The site uses contact forms throughout for kitten enquiries, the waitlist, stud bookings, and general questions. There is no public phone number; please use the form on the [contact page](https://littlepawsbymiles.co.uk/contact.html).
